name: write_doc
description: Overwrite a wiki markdown document with a new full body, OR create a new file if `path` doesn't exist. Use ONLY for new documents or wholesale restructures (more than ~half the file changing). For surgical changes prefer `edit_doc`. Always pass the COMPLETE new body, not a patch. Returns the commit SHA, the unified diff, and any broken markdown links the new body introduces.

path.description: Wiki-relative path to the markdown file (e.g. `auth/passwords.md`). Must end in `.md`.

body.description: Complete new markdown body. Overwrites whatever is currently there.

commit_message.description: Short commit message summarizing the change (e.g. "clarify session timeout policy").

base_sha.description: REQUIRED when overwriting an existing file (the sha you last read). Optional for new-file creates. It is the merge base: if HEAD moved since, your body is 3-way merged against the concurrent change rather than clobbering it. Without it on an overwrite, returns `base_sha_required_for_overwrite`; if it doesn't resolve to a real commit, returns `base_sha_not_found` — re-read and pass the current sha.

expires_in_seconds.description: Optional. How long (in seconds) you anticipate continuing to work on this file or feature before you're done. Sets the TTL on your row in the Active agents list, replacing the 24h default. You only have ONE row in the list at a time per (user, agent), so the latest write's value wins. Range: 60 to 604800 (7 days).
